snippet.title: 35 Electric - Teaser
snippet.description:
A former model moves to an unfamiliar neighborhood in the Pacific Northwest and finds it harder than usual to make friends. 

A new one-and-done visual novel from the writer/artist/composer of Misericorde. 

For more information:

xeecee.com/35electric

To support development:

patreon.com/xeecee
